item.title: Derivative from the Limit of a Difference Quotient
item.stimulus: Let f be the function defined by f(x) = 3/(x + 1) for x ≠ −1. In this question, use the definition of the derivative as the limit of a difference quotient. Do not use derivative rules such as the power rule.
item.verification_python:
import sympy as sp
x,h=sp.symbols('x h')
f=3/(x+1)
assert f.subs(x,2)==1
dq=sp.simplify((f.subs(x,2+h)-f.subs(x,2))/h)
assert sp.simplify(dq-(-1/(3+h)))==0
d=sp.limit(dq,h,0)
assert d==sp.Rational(-1,3)
assert d==sp.diff(f,x).subs(x,2)
tan=1+d*(x-2)
assert sp.simplify(tan-(-x/3+sp.Rational(5,3)))==0
expr=(sp.sqrt(9+h)-3)/h
conj=sp.simplify(expr*(sp.sqrt(9+h)+3)/(sp.sqrt(9+h)+3))
assert sp.simplify(conj-1/(sp.sqrt(9+h)+3))==0
L=sp.limit(expr,h,0)
assert L==sp.Rational(1,6)
assert sp.diff(sp.sqrt(x),x).subs(x,9)==L
assert abs(float(L)-0.1667)<1e-3 and abs(float(d)+0.333)<1e-3
print('ALL_CHECKS_PASSED')

criteria.text: Writes a correct limit definition for f′(2): f′(2) = lim h→0 [f(2 + h) − f(2)]/h = lim h→0 [3/(3 + h) − 1]/h
criteria.evidence: A limit of a difference quotient at x = 2 with h → 0 (or an equivalent form such as lim x→2 [f(x) − f(2)]/(x − 2)), with f(2) = 1 or f(2 + h) = 3/(3 + h) substituted.
criteria.fix: Start every definition problem by writing lim h→0 [f(a + h) − f(a)]/h, then substitute a and the formula for f.

criteria.text: Simplifies the difference quotient by combining fractions so the factor h cancels, giving −1/(3 + h)
criteria.evidence: Algebra combining 3/(3 + h) − 1 into −h/(3 + h), then dividing by h to reach −1/(3 + h) (or −1/(x + 1) in the x → 2 form) before taking the limit.
criteria.fix: Combine the fractions over a common denominator first, then cancel h before letting h approach 0.

criteria.text: Evaluates the limit to get f′(2) = −1/3
criteria.evidence: States f′(2) = −1/3 as the result of taking the limit of the simplified expression.
criteria.fix: After cancelling h, substitute h = 0 into the simplified expression to evaluate the limit.

criteria.fix: Use point-slope form y − f(a) = f′(a)(x − a), with the derivative value as the slope.

item.title: Limit Definition of the Derivative and Tangent Lines
item.stimulus: Let f be the function defined by f(x) = 2x² − 5x for all real numbers x. Let k be the function defined by k(x) = √x for x ≥ 0.
item.model_answer:
(a) f′(x) = lim h→0 [f(x+h) − f(x)]/h = lim h→0 [2(x+h)² − 5(x+h) − (2x² − 5x)]/h = lim h→0 [2x² + 4xh + 2h² − 5x − 5h − 2x² + 5x]/h = lim h→0 (4xh + 2h² − 5h)/h = lim h→0 (4x + 2h − 5) = 4x − 5. So f′(x) = 4x − 5.

(b) f(3) = 2(9) − 5(3) = 3, and the slope is f′(3) = 4(3) − 5 = 7. The tangent line is y = 3 + 7(x − 3).

(c) Since k(9+h) = √(9+h) and k(9) = √9 = 3, the expression is lim h→0 [k(9+h) − k(9)]/h, which is the definition of k′(9). Evaluating: [√(9+h) − 3]/h · [√(9+h) + 3]/[√(9+h) + 3] = (9 + h − 9)/[h(√(9+h) + 3)] = 1/(√(9+h) + 3). Then lim h→0 1/(√(9+h) + 3) = 1/(3 + 3) = 1/6. So k′(9) = 1/6.
item.verification_python:
import sympy as sp
x,h=sp.symbols('x h')
f=lambda t:2*t**2-5*t
num=sp.expand(f(x+h)-f(x))
assert sp.simplify(num-(4*x*h+2*h**2-5*h))==0
q=sp.simplify(num/h)
assert sp.simplify(q-(4*x+2*h-5))==0
fp=sp.limit(num/h,h,0)
assert sp.simplify(fp-(4*x-5))==0
assert f(3)==3
assert fp.subs(x,3)==7
assert sp.expand(3+7*(x-3))==7*x-18
L=sp.limit((sp.sqrt(9+h)-3)/h,h,0)
assert L==sp.Rational(1,6)
assert sp.simplify((sp.sqrt(9+h)-3)/h-1/(sp.sqrt(9+h)+3))==0
assert sp.diff(sp.sqrt(x),x).subs(x,9)==sp.Rational(1,6)
assert abs(float(L)-0.1667)<1e-3
print('ALL_CHECKS_PASSED')

item.title: Derivative from the Limit Definition and Tangent Lines
item.stimulus:
Let f be the function defined by f(x) = 6/(x + 2) for x ≠ −2.

Also, for a certain function g, the limit lim h→0 [√(9 + h) − 3]/h represents the derivative g′(9), written as the limit of a difference quotient.

Answer all parts of the following question. Do not use derivative rules in parts (a) or (c); work from the definition of the derivative and algebraic properties of limits.
item.verification_python:
import sympy as sp
x,h=sp.symbols('x h')
f=6/(x+2)
assert f.subs(x,1)==2
dq=(f.subs(x,1+h)-f.subs(x,1))/h
assert sp.simplify(dq-(-2/(3+h)))==0
fp1=sp.limit(dq,h,0)
assert fp1==sp.Rational(-2,3)
assert sp.diff(f,x).subs(x,1)==sp.Rational(-2,3)
T=2-sp.Rational(2,3)*(x-1)
assert sp.simplify(T-(-sp.Rational(2,3)*x+sp.Rational(8,3)))==0
assert sp.simplify(2*x+3*T-8)==0
g=sp.sqrt(x)
assert g.subs(x,9)==3
expr=(sp.sqrt(9+h)-3)/h
assert sp.simplify(expr-1/(sp.sqrt(9+h)+3))==0
L=sp.limit(expr,h,0)
assert L==sp.Rational(1,6)
assert sp.diff(g,x).subs(x,9)==sp.Rational(1,6)
assert abs(float(fp1)+0.6667)<1e-3 and abs(float(L)-0.1667)<1e-3
print('ALL_CHECKS_PASSED')
